map.太阳赤纬 δ = 23.45° × sin(360° × (n + 284) /: Solar declination delta = 23.45 degrees x sin(360 degrees x (n + 284) / 365)

map.高度角 α = arcsin(sinδ·sinφ + cosδ·cosφ·cos: Elevation angle alpha = arcsin(sin delta x sin phi + cos delta x cos phi x cos H)
